notes.title: Update 0.9.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, these are the patch notes for today's update

Changelog 0.9.2
What's new?

 New mini boss added: Mega bat. 2 Mega bats will appear at wave 12 and fly around the player's base. Defeat them before they reach the extractor!

Balancing

 Gigantism cursed gem health increase effect reduced from +40% to +25%.
 Dwarfism cursed gem health reduction effect increased from -10% to -15%.
 Shaman's health reduced from 140 to 100. Their Magic resistance was also reduced from 65% to 55%.
 Alpha War Wolf's health reduced from 1120 to 840. Its gold loot was increased from 325 to 650.
 Bharisia's magic resistance increased from 50% to 60%. (ground and flying)
 Ground Bharisia's gold loot increased from 600 to 1000. She now provides 150 gems and 2000 score points.
 Fixed how tower upgrade prices are calculated. Per each level the upgrade price is correctly increased by 10%. Before it was increasing exponentially.
 When playing a tower card its price will increase by its base price, instead of doubling the current price.
For example, an archer tower card will now cost 60 -> 120 -> 180 -> 240. Before, its cost was 60 -> 120 -> 240 -> 480.
 Spawners during a boss fight will re-spawn the enemies every 24 seconds instead of 6.
 Slime mutation does not affect flying minions anymore.

Fixes

 Fixed an issue that was causing the wave to never end when a riflemen tower instantly destroys a creep that just spawned in a mini boss spawner.

Other

 We are preparing the game for the lots of new content to come :)

notes.title: Update 0.9.1 - Beta
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We found a couple of things in yesterday's update, some of them very critical. But nothing to worry about, they are fixed by this hotfix! :D
We also have fixed some issues from previous versions. And added some enhancements and balacing changes.

Changelog

What's new?

 Towers stunned by Bharisia have a new animation! It is clearer to understand and more consistent with the game's overall art style.
 Recycled towers with level greater than 1 will display their level in their respective card.

Balancing

 Increased Bharisia's attack range from 500 to 600 when she is flying.
 Increased Bharisia's attack range from 400 to 500 when she is walking.
 Increased Bharisia's maximum targets from 2 to 3 when she is walking (flying was already 3).
 Increased Bharisia's attack interval from 6 seconds to a random value between 6 and 7. Both flying and walking.
 Reduced gems of “easy” mode from 150 to 100. Regular mode was also reduced from 225 to 150 (as it was prior to 0.9.0)

Fixes

 Fixed tutorial gems gained been more than what was actually displayed during the run.
 Fixed Recycle spell not considering “Veteran training”'s cumulative damage on riflemen towers.
 Fixed Recycle spell not leveling up the towers correctly.
 Fixed Recycle spell not deactivating tower adjacency bonuses. Like "Arcanum Connection", or "Quick! give me an arrow". We also added a visual effect to illustrate this.
 Fixed stats and stat upgrades displaying as 0 instead of 0.xx on non-english languages. Basically decimals were not being applied.
 Fixed some minor strings in Spanish and Portuguese.

Other

 Bharisia attacks' animation was updated to match the new Tower stunned animation.
 The deck building tutorial will not appear anymore if players have the riflemen tower unlocked.
 Improved the reaction time of the player's hand. Now cards can be picked during the "draw animation", and it feels far more fluid.

notes.title: Update 0.9.0 - The Timelines Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today we come with a big update, which adds a whole new screen and a new spell. This update should be the last "big update" for the demo builds. After this the majority of our efforts will be on adding content for the final game release. As well as features such as Leaderboard and Achievements.

Let's dive into the details

Changelog: 0.9.0 - Beta

What's new?

 Branch (timeline) selection is now available whenever we start a branch!
    {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050246/b56092ef2f69b726b2fdd4e1e30ea8fd2704fba3.gif
    Every time you will start a new run, you will be able to choose a branch to start on. Branches can have random modifiers chosen from a curated list. 
    In addition to that, they will always have 2 base modifiers that determines the base difficulty of the branch. You can think of it as the base difficulty, like "easy" and "regular".
    There will be up to 3 branches on the full game (easy, regular, & hard), only the first 2 branches will be available on the demo.
    We also added a mini tutorial when you see the screen for the first time.
 New spell card! Recycle: allows to remove a tower from the map and puts it back on your hand, you can place the tower again for free. It is very useful for moving towers that weren't well positioned. The tower keeps its level.
 New rare superior gem! Recycling love: Gives 1 recycle spell card. It can be picked up to 2 times.
 The Recycle spell can be obtained on the skill tree as a starter card. It replaced the Demolish spell, and the Demolish spell replaced the Discard spell. 
 The Discard spell is not more available as a starting card. However it can still be obtained via superior gems. Up to 2 times.
 Added a micro tutorial for the deck building screen.

Balancing

 the "regular" difficulty (which was the only difficulty before this version) will now give +50% gems, applied to both extracted gems and gems obtained from creeps.
 Players can now choose the "easy" difficulty, which provides less stats to the enemies. Sometimes due to random modifiers, the normal branch may become easier than the easy one, if you have enough luck!
 There will be a "hard" difficulty (the third branch), but it will not be available during the demo. And it will require a boss trophy to unlock. What's that? You will hear about it soon...

Fixes

 Fixed an issue where 2x1 spell card didn't worked when there was a free tower card in the deck.
 Fixed the Curses cursed superior gem not giving more curses if chosen again.
 Fixed some superior gems that gave cards not giving another card when picked again.
 Fixed an issue that was causing some superior gems to appear as "unlocked" even if you have never seen them.

Other

 Added custom sound effects and pff smoke when destroying towers using the Demolish spell.
 The "get a tower if all card are walls" effect mentioned in a previous update will now also include spell cards and curses in consideration.
 Limited the game to 60 fps when Vsync is off.

notes.title: Update 0.8.1 - The Encyclopedia update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are just releasing the update 0.8.0! These were great weeks of work, and we could implement a big feature, which took almost the entirety of the development time... the Encyclopedia!, Take a look at the notes. We have included some images :)

Changelog

What's new?

 You can now check the Encyclopedia! There you can find information about all the enemies, towers, walls, spells, and superior gems that you have unlocked, and all those that you didn't unlock yet. Of course, you will need to discover them before seeing their details ;D
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050246/ca334e0d5f6763f99b73905e87ed03d624905ff7.png
 You can now see the superior gems chosen in the run! So you will not forget what you picked anymore!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050246/96b556041e4cbf21f2da0b0828a1a6970a6ea53d.png
 Previously, the extractor implosion effect was great, but it didn't feel right, because nothing happened after exploding, it was like it wasn't built at all... Well, not anymore! Now it will leave a hole of corruption after exploding! As well as some cracks on the ground
 2 new tips were added to the game. One about maze building that teaches a good strategy for placing walls. Which includes a picture! And another one about changing the tower's target priority.


Balancing

 Reduced swarm waves' enemies amount from 2.5x to 2x
 Swarm waves will now appear after wave 7 instead of 4.


Fixes

 Fixed an issue with some sounds not being updated with their respective volume sliders.
 Fixed an issue where destroying an archer tower with the Demolish spell while having the "Quick, Give me an arrow!" skill was allowing the player to place infinite free archer towers.
 Fix Bharisia's teleport VFX appearing on the ground instead of on her.
 Fixed an issue that was causing the enemies' death particle effects to not work properly when running the game at 120+ fps.


Other

 Removed the green texts that indicated the current cumulative sum of some statistics from the superior gem descriptions. It was confusing and sometimes didn't even reflect the real value. Also it is not needed anymore because we can see the stats directly in the towers and in the encyclopedia

notes.title: Update 0.7.0
notes.content:
Changelog

What's new?

 Added a Discard Pile!
    - Now you can see which cards are in your discard pile, and which are on your deck (psst! They are shuffled, so it's not cheating :p)
    - This includes some fancy animations when discarding cards and refilling the deck with the discarded cards.
 Now paths will update in real time while placing walls or towers. No more guessing where the enemies may go, yay!
 Added various story dialogues that appear after certain runs completed or specific events (for example. when meeting the first boss, or killing the first mini boss) We have also reduced the length of the starting dialogues.
 Added a Vsync option in the game settings. Enabled by default.
 Added a little description to explain what are the skill tree tiers' unlockables.
 Added a button to restart progress in the game settings.
 Added an "upgrade preview" in the tower stats when hovering the mouse over the level up button.
 General overhaul of the tower upgrades. Now towers will update different stats across the levels instead of just damage.
    - All towers: Increase the damage by a magic formula each level. (same as before) 
    - Archer tower: 

 +1% attack speed every 3rd level
 +1% critic chance every 5th level
 +2% critic damage every 2nd level
 +2% attack range every 6th level

    - Arcane mage tower:

 +1% attack speed every 4th level
 +1% critic chance every 3rd level
 +1% double attack chance every 5th level
 +1% attack range every 2nd level

    - Fire mage tower:

 It will now display the burning damage instead of the damage received by burning enemies.
        - +1% attack speed every 3rd level
        - +1% burn chance every 4th level
        - +0.2% burn damage every 3rd level
        - +1% attack range every 2nd level

    - Ice mage tower:

 +1% attack speed every 5th level
 +0.3% chilling power every level
 +0.1% freeze chance every 2nd level
 +1% attack range every 4th level

    - Rifleman tower:

 Gets even more damage every level
 +1% attack speed every 2nd level
 +1% critic chance every 5th level
 +0.03% chance of headshot every level

    - Catapult tower:

 Gets even more damage every level
 +1% attack speed every 4th level
 +2% area of effect every 3rd level
 +0.1% stun chance every 2nd level



Balancing

 Fixed an issue that was making **all** the enemies to have the health of the next wave instead of the current one (because each wave they become stronger). This issue was making the first waves harder than expected.
 Reduced Orcs' base health to 120 from 140
 Increased Shamans' base health to 140 from 120
 Reduced Goblin Chief's followers from 12 to 6
 Iron Arrows and Frenzy superior gems will not appear anymore during the tutorial.
 Players that didn't make past the first mini-boss in the tutorial (wave 3) will receive +100 bonus gems, so they can acquire up to 3 skills in the skill tree.
 Purge spell now removes a curse from any place, not only the hand.
 Skill Tree changes:
- Moved the Starting gold skill to Tier 2. 
- Moved the Gold mining skill to Tier 3.
- Moved the Extractor's health skill to Tier 1.
- Moved the 2-tiles wall card skill from Tier 1 to Tier 3, replacing the 3-tiles wall card skill.
- Increased Arcane Power's extra damage effect from 10% to 30%.


Fixes

 Fixed an issue that was impeding the scroll of the skill tree when the mouse was above a skill.
 Fixed an issue that was making the card's details tooltip appear on the card (hiding it) instead of above it on certain screen resolutions.
 Fixed an issue were the skill's details tooltip appeared "shrunk" right after buying another skill.


Other

 Improved loading times. The loading screen will **not** wait for 3 fixed seconds anymore.
 Reduced delay between last creep killed and extractor's extraction from 2 to 1.
 Reduced Run results spawn delay from 2 to 0.5. Its stats will now display a bit faster too.
 Improved superior gems selection screen overall animations speed.
 Reduced the chance of getting a hand full of walls. It is still possible to get a hand full of walls, but only if there are no towers in the deck (which means that they are in the discard pile). 
 Because of the item mentioned above, it is no longer possible to start a new run without a tower or spell in the hand.
 Updated various texts in the game to make them more descriptive, shorter, and clearer.
 Added a little fog effect in the ground below the portals.

notes.title: Update 0.6.0
notes.content:
Changelog

What's new?

 Implemented cards in the Skill Tree. Now every time you unlock a new card, a pretty popup will appear with the card's information.
 Added a custom feedback form for Spanish speaking players.


Balancing

 Shamans can now heal bosses.
 Shamans still heal a 30% of the target's max health, but the healing amount is now limited to 200 + 50 x wave.
 Shamans healing range was reduced from 2.5 to 2.3, to better match the visual effect's area.
 Shamans healing skill's cooldown was changed from 5 seconds to a random value between 4 and 7 seconds, recomputed after every use.
 Shamans' Healing particle effects are now triggered only on damaged enemies, increasing performance.

notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.content:
Changelog

What's new?

 Implemented controls indicators based on the context at the bottom right of the screen. They will indicate how to rotate a wall, cancel an action, or close the tower details.
 Implemented Lock cursor to screen feature.
 Enabled camera movement by moving the cursor over the screen borders.
 Implemented tower detail's stats overhaul. Now the primary stats of each specific tower are displayed. (for example, Ice mages now display chilling power and freeze chance, in addition to the 4 basic stats)


Fixes

 Fixed an issue that was displaying too many decimals on the settings screen, specifically in the screen resolutions dropdown.
 Fixed an issue where the music didn't started on the first wave. It should only happen on the tutorial waves.
 Fixed an issue that was displaying a tooltip after the section rewards popup was closed.

notes.title: Update 0.4.2 - More languages!
notes.content:
Changelog
Added support for Polish, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese
Various minor fixes on different texts to guarantee the correct display of the languages mentioned above.

notes.title: Update Iconia Defenders Beta testing: 0.4.1
notes.content:
Update 0.4.1 just released! Here is the changelog:

Whats new?

 International translations! -> French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, German
 Replaced all wall card and skill icons with better new icons. Made by Sara!


General:

 Removed big annoying walls : Crosshair & 4-corners.
 Replaced the word "creep" with "minion" to avoid any grammatical confusion in texts.
 Updated enemy tags in the enemy details modal.
 Removed "Special" target priority in towers because it was just confusing (it was only doing something in ice and fire mage towers). 
 Added "Not burning" target priority on Fire mage towers. This is now the default priority in Fire mages.
 Added "Not chilled" target priority on Ice mage towers.
 More variety in waves.
 Swarms can appear starting on wave 7.
 Added beta testers to the credits, Yay!


Superior gems:

 Arcane resonance now affects all mages.
 Veteran Training now give +20 damage immediately and +7 damage on every new wave, instead of +7 since built.
 Fixed Witch projectiles being intercepted by ogres

notes.title: Update 0.3.1 - Demo playtesting
notes.content:
This build includes two major content updates to the game. As well as a re-balancing of the current content and minor bug fixes.

This is what will be released for the public demo for the game once everything feels ready.

What's new?
* Meta-progression Skill Tree:  Up to 40 skills can be purchased in the game's skill tree. Full game will contain more than 150 skills.
* Meta-progression Skill Tree Tutorial:  a short tutorial was included in the skill tree menu.
* Deck-building:  players now will be able to select between 10 and 12 cards for the battle. Divided by towers, walls, and spells.
* Story:  A continuation of the story appears the first time visiting the skill tree (after finishing the first run)

Balancing:
* Creatures and towers were rebalanced to fit with the skill tree meta-progression, represent a challenge, and also to represent the whole game loop.
* The difficulty was heavily increased, enemies will now grow their health by 10 + 40% base health per wave. The skill tree's skills are meaningful as it is hard to progress without them.
* Waves are still limited to 14 (where Bharisia appears), and the boss can be beaten with the correct strategy and superior gems.
